plugins.name: agent-perform
plugins.description: A Claude Mod above the Claude Code prompt that keeps your context spending in check and builds good habits: live context use, a Cache countdown, this turn's context growth, quota use, warning colours past thresholds, and one-click /clear, /compact and /recap once context passes 30%. Comes with a large local dashboard at localhost:8787 that drills into every conversation and turn to find where tokens were spent abnormally.

plugins.name: archify-review
plugins.description: Code review for a commit or a Jira ticket's commits as an explorable standalone HTML report: an architecture diagram of the change, net diffs per flow with each changed function's test coverage and Given/When/Then cases, reviewed checkboxes, Code Review / Security / Code Smell TODOs with copyable AI prompts, and copyable reference links. Based on the open-source archify.
